RSS forms panel to propose curbs on OTT content

The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) has formed an informal panel to propose regulations for Over-The-Top (OTT) streaming platforms. This move follows RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's previous statements blaming OTT platforms for "moral corruption" and "cultural pollution." The panel includes former Vice-Chancellors and pracharaks, and it is expected to submit its proposals to the government. The RSS aims to curb perceived obscenity and cultural pollution on these platforms.
